en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Speaker changes between verses and some lines are ambiguous; verse 2 and 3 are my reading. Line 'ко не си воен' I read as 'because you are not a warrior'.

lines.cyr: в' рајски градини, в' рајски градини
lines.lat: v' rajski gradini, v' rajski gradini
lines.en: in the gardens of paradise, in the gardens of paradise
I shed tears, I shed tears.

lines.cyr: С' превез девојче плаче над гроб
lines.lat: S' prevez devojče plače nad grob
lines.en: With a veil a girl weeps over the grave

lines.cyr: и ми се смеит, и ми се смеит
lines.lat: i mi se smeit, i mi se smeit
lines.en: and he laughs at me, and he laughs at me

lines.cyr: да сум бил роб, да сум бил роб.
lines.lat: da sum bil rob, da sum bil rob.
lines.en: that I was a slave, that I was a slave.

lines.cyr: Не си достоен, ох ангел мој
lines.lat: Ne si dostoen, oh angel moj
lines.en: You are not worthy, oh my angel

lines.cyr: ко не си воен, не си достоен
lines.lat: ko ne si voen, ne si dostoen
lines.en: because you are not a warrior, you are not worthy

lines.cyr: јунак во бој, јунак во бој.
lines.lat: junak vo boj, junak vo boj.
lines.en: of a hero in battle, a hero in battle.
I will come myself, my dear

lines.cyr: крст да ти сложам, венец да положам
lines.lat: krst da ti složam, venec da položam
lines.en: to place a cross for you, to lay a wreath

lines.cyr: на гробот твој, на гробот твој.
lines.lat: na grobot tvoj, na grobot tvoj.
lines.en: on your grave, on your grave.
